note: Capy (capy.ai) is the rebranded, pivoted product of Scrapybara, Inc. (YC Fall 2024, founders Nalin Semwal and Justin Sun): the company's schema.org data and about page link back to the original YC listing at ycombinator.com/companies/scrapybara, and the about page states 'Capy is built by Scrapybara, Inc.' Scrapybara originally sold API-controlled virtual desktop/computer-use environments for AI agents ('Scrapybara - A Computer for Your AI'); it has since discontinued that product and repositioned as an AI-native parallel coding-agent IDE under the Capy brand. Only one priced round (pre-seed/seed, ~$500K, YC + BoxGroup) is visible via aggregators (Crunchbase/Tracxn); no confirmed press coverage of any funding round (including whether it has raised beyond the YC-era round) was found in the ~15 minutes budgeted. Revenue figure is a third-party estimate (GetLatka) predating the Capy rebrand and pricing-plan launch, so current ARR is likely different/unknown.
